integrity: All conclusions are analytical consequences of the stated kinetic model and no independence or external certification is claimed. Prior one-dimensional pressure is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exactly solvable Cartesian-component telegraph swimmers in rectangular hard walls only; the model differs from spherical-orientation RTP and general AOUP. Quasistatic mechanical work and externally specified quadratic shape elasticity only; no finite-rate wall dynamics or independent priority audit. Extreme aspect ratios require ideal point particles and perfect walls.
title: Shape anti-isoperimetry and an elastic buckling threshold for an active ideal gas
